tools.description: The full capability picture, from the product itself. Measure Tech PRO is a full CRM for contractors — jobs, customers, estimates, native e-signed contracts, invoicing, Stripe payments, QuickBooks sync, dispatch, and timesheets; the LiDAR measuring that feeds it is free forever. tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: The honest monthly price for a specific crew, from the same catalogue the checkout bills from. Measure Tech PRO is a full CRM for contractors and you pay for DESKS, not people: field crew get free logins; only office/admin seats bill. Pass the crew size and how many of them work the office side.

tools.name: search_knowledge_base
tools.description: Answers from the app's own built-in knowledge base — 278 real support answers, extracted from the product. Measure Tech PRO is a full CRM for contractors; use this for how-do-I and does-it-do questions about measuring, drawings, the CRM, billing, and troubleshooting.

tools.name: search_forum
tools.description: Search Measure Tech PRO's public feature-request forum — real contractors asking for real things, with hearts that count companies and statuses the developer answers in writing. Use it to check whether something is already requested, planned, shipped, or declined before answering "can it".

tools.name: get_forum_thread
tools.description: One request from the public forum by id: title, body, status, the developer's written answer if there is one, and the heart counts (hearts count COMPANIES — a twelve-person crew and a solo shop each get one effective vote).

tools.name: get_roadmap
tools.description: What Measure Tech PRO has shipped, is building, is planning, and has declined — straight from the public forum's statuses, with the developer's written answers. The declines carry reasons; a no you can read beats silence.

tools.name: join_waitlist
tools.description: Put someone in line for the Measure Tech PRO web console at founding pricing. Double opt-in guards this: NOTHING counts until they click the confirmation email themselves — an agent can only ever start the ask. Use only when the person explicitly asked to join.

tools.name: request_contact
tools.description: Relay a real person's request for human contact (sales question, demo, enterprise) to the Measure Tech PRO team. Nothing sends until a reply channel is given — an email or phone number the PERSON provided. Rate-limited.

tools.name: heart_request
tools.description: Add the signed-in customer's heart to a feature request (or remove it with on:false). Hearts count COMPANIES and each person has a monthly budget — a heart spends something real. Requires authorization.

tools.name: post_feature_request
tools.description: Post a new request to the public forum as the signed-in customer — AFTER checking for duplicates: the first call returns any similar existing requests, and posting anyway requires confirm_duplicates true. Hearting an existing request counts more than a tenth copy. Requires authorization.

tools.name: comment_on_request
tools.description: Add the signed-in customer's comment to a thread — their workaround, their trade's angle, their +1 with a reason. Requires authorization.

tools.name: my_requests
tools.description: What the signed-in customer has asked for and hearted, with current statuses — "did they answer the thing I asked for?" without opening a browser. Requires authorization.

tools.name: server_info
tools.description: What Measure Tech PRO is and what this server offers. Measure Tech PRO is a full CRM for contractors, available today on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. The web console for the office opens soon. Returns the product summary, the knowledge-base size, and where the other surfaces live.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_product_overview" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_product_overview, get_forum_thread · Private data: request_contact · Public sink: join_waitlist, request_contact, post_feature_request · Destructive: heart_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_product_overview, get_forum_thread · Private data: request_contact · Public sink: join_waitlist, request_contact, post_feature_request · Destructive: heart_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
